violation_type.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - Greater than Six Feet No Overlap (26 TAC §747.4605(d))
violation_type.short_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - Greater than Six Feet No Overlap
violation_type.typical_finding: It was found during the inspection that the  use zone in front of the plastic slides exits overlapped the use zone of the wooden play structure.
